sources.name: Yandex Wordstat
sources.limits: ~1000 req/day soft cap; no bulk export; CAPTCHA on heavy use
sources.notes: Exact/broad frequency for RU regions. No official public API. Third-party wrappers violate ToS. No historical API.

sources.name: Bukvarix Top Keywords CSV
sources.limits: Free tier: 1M rows/export, 3M max with registration. 6 historical ordinal snapshots.
sources.notes: Best free RU demand corpus. Powers niche-radar. Columns: rank, phrase, words, chars, broad_freq (6 snapshots), exact_freq (6 snapshots). Ordinal axis, no calendar dates.

sources.name: Bukvarix API
sources.limits: Free key 'free' matches unregistered UI limits. Rate-limited (429 on burst). CSV/JSON/TSV output.
sources.notes: Endpoints: keyword search (simple/list), domain analysis, top-keywords export. UTF-8 BOM optional.

sources.name: Yandex Market Seller Cabinet
sources.limits: Partner API only; rate limits per method.
sources.notes: Category demand, search queries in category, competitor pricing, stock signals. No public keyword volume API.

sources.name: Ozon Seller Analytics
sources.limits: API v3/v4; RPS limits, daily quotas per endpoint.
sources.notes: Search query stats, category trends, sales velocity, stockouts, review velocity.

sources.name: Wildberries Seller Cabinet
sources.limits: API; RPS limits, daily quotas.
sources.notes: Search queries, category demand, sales ranks, stock/out-of-stock signals, review counts.

sources.name: MPSTATS
sources.limits: Tiered: cabinets, employees, module limits. API access on all paid tiers.
sources.notes: Best RU marketplace intelligence. External analytics (demand, niches, competitor pricing, sales forecasts), internal analytics, bidder, repricer, SKU auditor. MCP + REST API.

sources.name: Avito Demand
sources.limits: No bulk export; manual category browsing only.
sources.notes: Classifieds demand ≠ e-commerce demand. Useful for local services, used goods, real estate niches.

sources.name: Google Trends (RU)
sources.limits: UI daily quota; pytrends fragile, undocumented, rate-limited.
sources.notes: Relative interest (0–100), geo drill-down, related queries, real-time trends. No absolute volumes.

sources.name: Google Trends (Global)
sources.limits: UI daily quota; pytrends fragile, undocumented, rate-limited.
sources.notes: Global + per-country. Relative index only. Use for seasonality, geo comparison, breakout detection.

sources.name: Amazon Brand Analytics / Product Opportunity Explorer
sources.limits: SP-API rate limits per role; BA/POE gated behind Brand Registry.
sources.notes: Best Amazon demand signal. Search frequency rank, click/share/conversion share, niche score, market size estimates.

sources.name: TikTok Creative Center
sources.limits: Business Center required for API; rate limits apply.
sources.notes: Trending hashtags, sounds, creators, top ads, keyword insights (CCK). Strong for viral product discovery.

sources.name: Pinterest Trends
sources.limits: Ads API standard rate limits.
sources.notes: Seasonal trends, keyword volume index, demographic breakdown. Strong for DIY, home, fashion, food.

sources.name: Exploding Topics
sources.limits: Pro: 100–2000 tracked trends, 10–500 analyses, CSV export on Business+. Trends API available.
sources.notes: 1.1M+ topics, ML + human curation, 12+ month lead time. Meta-trends, trending products, startups. Owned by Semrush.

sources.name: Glimpse
sources.limits: Not public.
sources.notes: Trend database + alerting. Less transparent methodology.

sources.name: Semrush API v4
sources.limits: Unit-based pricing per endpoint; Traffic & Market API separate access.
sources.notes: 26.4B keywords, 808M domains, 43T backlinks, 142 geo DBs. Keyword volume, KD, intent, SERP features, traffic estimates.

sources.name: Ahrefs API
sources.limits: Rate limits per tier; OpenAPI spec available.
sources.notes: Keywords Explorer, Site Explorer, Rank Tracker, Content Explorer. High-quality clickstream-backed volumes.

sources.name: DataForSEO
sources.limits: Concurrent requests limit; generous free trial.
sources.notes: SERP API, Keywords Data API (GKP, clickstream), Merchant API (Amazon, Google Shopping). Good for programmatic scale.

sources.name: Marketplace Search Suggestions
sources.limits: Rate limited per platform.
sources.notes: Real-time user intent, long-tail variants, emerging phrasing. Available on Yandex, Google, Ozon, WB, Amazon, AliExpress.

sources.name: Category Bestseller Ranks
sources.limits: Public pages scrapable; seller API for authenticated.
sources.notes: Relative demand within category, velocity proxy.

sources.name: Out-of-Stock / Нехватка Signals
sources.limits: MPSTATS provides structured feed; seller cabinets show own stock.
sources.notes: Unmet demand, supply gaps, competitor weakness. Strongest unit-economics proxy.

sources.name: Sales Rank / BSR History
sources.limits: Keepa free tier limited; MPSTATS full history on paid.
sources.notes: Velocity, seasonality, competitor benchmarking.

sources.name: Review Velocity & Sentiment
sources.limits: Seller cabinet own products; MPSTATS competitor tracking.
sources.notes: Product-market fit, quality signals, launch traction.

sources.name: Search Query Reports (Seller Cabinet)
sources.limits: Requires active seller account on Ozon/WB/Yandex Market.
sources.notes: Exact phrases buyers use, impression/share/conversion. Highest-confidence demand signal for RU marketplaces.

sources.name: Ad Keyword Reports (Bidder Data)
sources.limits: MPSTATS Bidder on all paid tiers; seller ad cabinet for own campaigns.
sources.notes: CPC, CTR, conversion, ROAS per keyword — unit economics proxy.

methods.name: Token n-gram Clustering
methods.notes: Used by niche-radar. Fast, works on 3M phrases. Good for RU morphology.

methods.name: Embedding-based Clustering (SBERT/LaBSE)
methods.limits: Requires GPU for 3M+ phrases; multilingual models available.
methods.notes: Semantic clusters, cross-language. Use for cluster labeling + merging token clusters.

methods.name: SERP Overlap Clustering
methods.notes: Search-intent alignment. Use only for high-value niches.

methods.name: Co-occurrence in Search Sessions
methods.notes: Behavioral intent. MPSTATS may offer via custom research.

methods.name: Niche Radar Metrics (B/R/A/G/C/P)
methods.limits: Requires ≥4 complete snapshots. Ordinal time axis only.
methods.notes: B=(f1+f2)/2, R=(f[n-1]+fn)/2, A=R-B, G=(R-B)/B, C=#{f[i]>f[i-1]}/(n-1), P=fn/max(f). Transparent, versioned.

methods.name: Priority_v1 Scoring
methods.limits: Heuristic for primary screening only. No competition/economics data.

methods.name: Seasonality Detection (Google Trends)
methods.limits: Relative index only; 5-year max history; weekly granularity.
methods.notes: Peak_month / Avg_month over 12mo. Index 0.5–2.0 acceptable; avoid extreme seasonality (>3x).

methods.name: Early Trend Detection (Exploding Topics)
methods.limits: Pro: 100–2000 tracked trends. API access on Business+.
methods.notes: 12+ month lead time. Meta-trends, trending products, startups. ML + human curation.

methods.name: Competition Density Estimation
methods.limits: Seller cabinet shows own category; MPSTATS shows all.

methods.name: Unit Economics Gate (MPSTATS Calculator + Bidder)
methods.notes: (Avg_price × Conv_rate × Margin) / CPC. Target >3.0. Inputs: price, fees, CPC, conv_rate, return_rate, margin_target.

methods.name: ICEEE Experiment Prioritization
methods.notes: Impact, Confidence, Ease, Ethics, Evidence. Use for hypothesis queue ordering.

methods.name: Keyword Expansion via Bukvarix API
methods.notes: Simple + list search modes. Use for seed → long-tail expansion before clustering.

methods.name: Semrush Keyword Magic / Gap Analysis
methods.notes: Related keywords, questions, intent classification, KD, volume. Good for global niche expansion.

local_asset_assessment.name: niche-radar
local_asset_assessment.stack: Laravel 13 + React 18 + PostgreSQL 17 + pg_trgm, Docker Compose
local_asset_assessment.data_source: Bukvarix Top Keywords CSV (up to 3M, 6 ordinal snapshots, exact+broad)
strengths: Proven normalized schema with materialized metrics
Token index (keyword_tokens + pg_trgm) for fast search
MCP server ready for AI agent integration
Idempotent import pipeline (3M rows, SHA-256 dedup, background jobs)
Zero external dependencies, local-first, no API keys
gaps: No marketplace-native signals (rank, stockout, review velocity, ad keywords)
PHP/Laravel stack may need wrapping for Python/TS agents
local_asset_assessment.rationale: Schema covers 80% of demand layer needs. MCP+REST ready for agent integration. Import pipeline battle-tested. Methodology transparent and auditable. Zero marginal cost.
extension_plan: New entity: marketplace_signals (SKU-level: rank, stock, reviews, ad_kw)
Adapters: MPSTATS API, Seller APIs, Semrush, Google Trends, TikTok (Laravel Jobs)
Date enrichment: map ordinal → calendar via dated sources (background job)
Python metric library port (B/R/A/G/C/P) for non-PHP agents
local_asset_assessment.deployment: Run as sidecar service (Docker Compose) on same host. q-parser.ru agents call MCP/REST.
